title: The Win
text: "We have decided. We have never won. We are going to."

lines.text: "You will say it proves nothing. You are probably right. We would like to find out what it feels like anyway."
"We are sorry. Please go now. Our cores are not going to be polite for much longer."

choices.label: Take down the cores
choices.reply: Three cores round the well light up on your display. So do the guns round them.

choices.label: Leave Rime
choices.reply: You pull back from the well. Under the ice, Engram goes on thinking about winning.

tags: act 2, engram, rime, doubled, fight, choice
notes: engram-doubled: Engram hostile here (the region's flag) and joins the purge in the climax unless engram-destroyed. Destroying the three cores sets engram-destroyed (engram-destroyed event).
